name: Apollonian Gasket

name: Clifford Attractor

name: Space Colonisation Tree

name: Diffusion Aggregation

name: Dragon Curve

name: Flow Field

name: Game of Life

name: Hilbert Curve

name: Julia Set

name: L-System Plant

name: Langton's Ant

name: Reaction Diffusion

name: Rule 30

name: Voronoi Cells

name: Architecture Map

name: Binary Search Steps
note: Binary search on a sorted array of twenty numbers, with lo, mid and hi pointers sliding into place, the discarded half greying out at every step and a log of each comparison until the target is found or proven missing.

name: Binary Search Tree
note: Values inserting into a binary search tree one by one, each comparison lighting the path down before the new node drops into place.

name: Edge Cache Hit Miss

name: CI Pipeline
note: A CI pipeline where each run moves through checkout, install, lint, test, build and deploy, with spinners, timings, a live log and the odd failing test.

name: Circuit Breaker States

name: Consistent Hash Ring

name: ETL Data Flow
note: An ETL pipeline where raw records leave three sources, pass through clean, dedupe and join steps, and land in a warehouse as counters climb.

name: Primary Replica Sync
note: Database replication where every write is appended to the primary's log and streamed to three replicas, one cross-region with visible lag and one that loses its link and then catches up in a burst.

name: Dijkstra Shortest Path
note: Dijkstra's algorithm on a weighted graph, popping the closest node from the priority queue, relaxing each edge and updating distances, then lighting the shortest route from A to O.

name: DNS Lookup Path
note: A DNS lookup where the resolver asks the root, then the TLD, then the authoritative server, caches each referral and answers the repeat query in two milliseconds.

name: ER Diagram
note: An entity relationship diagram of a shop database where each foreign key link lights up in turn with its join written below.

name: Flowchart
note: An order flowchart of boxes and a decision diamond, with a token travelling the arrows, looping back on an error and logging each step.

name: Gantt Chart

name: Git Branch Graph

name: Gradient Descent Contours

name: Load Balancer

name: LRU Cache Eviction

name: MapReduce Word Count

name: Mind Map

name: Network Topology
note: A mesh of routers and links with coloured packets hopping node to node along their routes, each link glowing as traffic passes.

name: Neural Net Forward Pass

name: OAuth Code Flow

name: Org Chart

name: Sequence Diagram

name: State Machine

name: Timeline
note: A horizontal company timeline where a moving marker reveals each milestone, labels popping up above and below the line.

name: Twisted Rope

name: Twinkle Star Band

name: Download Queue
note: A download manager where six files report size, speed and time left, then finish one by one.

name: File Tree
note: A project explorer where a cursor walks the tree, opening and closing folders as it goes.

name: Profiler Flame Graph
note: A CPU profiler flame graph whose stacks grow and settle as samples come in while a cursor inspects the hottest frames.

name: Form Validation Errors
note: A form is submitted half filled, red errors drop in under each bad field, then each one is corrected until it submits clean.

name: Git Log Graph
note: A git log graph with feature branches merging back into main as new commits land on top.

name: Heap Allocator Map
note: A memory allocator page map where blocks are allocated and freed, fragmentation builds up and a compaction pass packs it tight.

name: Debugger Stepping
note: An editor debugger steps line by line through a loop, pausing on breakpoints while locals, watches and the call stack change.

name: Container Layer Pull
note: A container image pull where each layer downloads with its own progress bar, extracts and completes, ending with a digest.

name: Inbox List
note: An email inbox with unread dots, stars and previews, where new mail slides in at the top.

name: Infra Plan and Apply
note: An infrastructure-as-code plan that lists resources to add, change and destroy in coloured diffs, then applies them with elapsed timers.

name: Install Log
note: A package manager install log resolving, fetching and linking packages, ending in a green summary.

name: Kanban Board
note: A three column task board where cards lift, travel across and settle into place.

name: Keyboard Keypress
note: A keyboard where each key sinks and lights as a sentence is typed into the text field above it, shift and space included.

name: Login Form
note: A sign-in card where the email and password fill in, the button presses and a success tick draws itself.

name: Maintenance Mode
note: A be right back page with a turning gear, a rocking wrench and a live list of upgrade steps.

name: Merge Conflict Resolver
note: A three pane merge editor walks through conflicting hunks, accepting ours, theirs or both until the file is clean.

name: Modal Dialog
note: A delete confirmation dialog pops up over a dimmed settings page, takes a typed name and closes.

name: Modal Editor Session
note: A modal terminal text editor where the cursor hops, a line is deleted, a new one inserted, a search and replace runs and the file is saved.

name: Request Waterfall
note: A browser network panel where requests appear as a page loads, each with queue, connect, wait and download segments on a waterfall.

name: Onboarding Stepper
note: A setup wizard walks through four steps, filling fields, picking options and ticking the stepper rail as it goes.

name: OTP Code Entry
note: A two step verification screen where a six digit code is typed, shakes as wrong, is retyped and goes green.

name: Package Publish
note: A terminal packs a package, lists its files, publishes it to the registry, and the weekly downloads graph beside it starts to climb.

name: Packet Capture
note: A packet capture tool streaming colour-coded TCP, UDP, DNS and TLS packets with protocol counters and a hex dump of the selected packet.

name: Lost In Space 404
note: A not found page with a big glowing 404 and a lost satellite drifting through twinkling stars.

name: Server Error 500
note: A 500 error page with a smoking server rack, blinking fault lights and a retry countdown.

name: Password Strength Meter
note: A password field where each keystroke moves a strength meter from weak to strong and ticks off the rules.

name: Pod Autoscaler
note: A container cluster view where a traffic spike pushes CPU up, new pods spin up across the nodes, then scale back down as load eases.

name: Power-On Memory Count
note: A retro power-on self test that counts up memory, detects drives one by one and hands off to the boot loader.

name: Pull Request Merged
note: A pull request page where the checks turn green one by one, a review approves it and the merge button lands it, branch deleted.

name: Pricing Plan Toggle
note: A three plan pricing table where the billing switch flips between monthly and yearly, prices roll to the new numbers and a plan is picked.

name: Process Viewer Sort
note: An interactive process viewer with meter bars where the table slides into a new order as the sort column changes.

name: Process Task Manager
note: A task manager where per process CPU and memory numbers churn, rows slide to re-sort by load, and a runaway process gets ended.

name: Process Tree Live
note: A live process tree with branch lines where build workers and request handlers spawn in green, run and exit in red.

name: Progress Loader
note: Four terminal progress bars filling at their own pace, with percent and a spinner.

name: README Badge Row
note: A README's badge row where build turns passing, coverage climbs, downloads tick up and the star count rolls over.

name: Interactive Rebase Todo
note: An interactive rebase todo list where commits are squashed, reworded, dropped and reordered before the rebase replays them.

name: Relay Chat Channel
note: A terminal relay chat client where people join and leave a channel, chat with timestamps and the nick list updates beside them.

name: Release Published
note: A terminal tags v1.1.0, pushes it, and the release notes type themselves out with new features, fixes and thanks to contributors.

name: Star Button Click
note: A repository header with Watch, Fork and Star buttons: the cursor glides over, clicks Star, and the count ticks over to your number.

name: Search Autocomplete
note: A search box where suggestions narrow and highlight with every keystroke, then a result is picked with the arrow keys.

name: Settings Toggles
note: A settings panel where a focus marker moves down the list, flipping switches and dragging sliders.

name: Skeleton Loader
note: Shimmering skeleton placeholders for a feed of cards that dissolve into the real content.

name: Smart Home Panel
note: A home dashboard where lights flip on room by room, the thermostat climbs to its target, the door locks and the energy graph scrolls.

name: Spectrum Music Player
note: A music player window with bouncing spectrum bars, a moving progress bar and a playlist that advances track by track.

name: Spinner Set
note: Twelve classic terminal spinners side by side, each labelled with its name and frame count.

name: Split Pane Multiplexer
note: A terminal multiplexer split into a streaming server log, a live resource meter and a test watcher, with focus hopping between panes.

name: Spreadsheet Recalc
note: A budget spreadsheet where a cell is edited, its formula bar updates and the dependent totals flash as they recalculate.

name: SQL Query Runner
note: A database console types a SQL query with highlighting, runs it and fills a result grid with rows and timing.

name: Secure Shell Login
note: A remote shell session that accepts a host key, prints a welcome banner with system stats, runs two commands and logs out.

name: Star Rating Review
note: A review card where the cursor hovers across five stars, settles on a rating, writes a short review and posts it to the tally.

name: Tab Bar
note: An editor tab bar where the active underline slides between files and the content swaps beneath.

name: Terminal Session
note: A shell session where commands are typed at a coloured prompt and their output streams back.

name: Test Suite Dots
note: A test runner that prints a dot per passing test across files, flags a failure with a diff and ends in a coloured summary.

name: Toast Stack
note: Notification toasts slide into the corner of an app, stack up, count down and slide away.

name: Twin Pane Commander
note: A retro two-pane file manager where the cursor picks files, a copy dialog fills its progress bar and the files land in the other pane.

name: Upload Dropzone
note: A cursor drags a stack of files onto a drop zone that lights up, then each file uploads with its own progress bar.

name: Weather City Widget
note: A weather widget that slides from city to city, each with an animated sky icon, hourly temperatures and a five day outlook.

name: Window Tiling Manager
note: A desktop where windows open one by one and the tiling layout slides between halves, columns and a grid.

name: Cylinder
note: A striped cylinder tumbling slowly in space, its curved side and flat caps lit and depth-sorted.

name: Double Helix
note: Two glossy strands twisting around each other like DNA, joined by coloured base pairs and depth-sorted as they turn.

name: Gimbal Gyroscope
note: A gyroscope of three nested gold, steel and copper rings, each turning on its own pivot around a fast spinning rotor disc.

name: Heart 3D
note: A solid 3D heart surface beating slowly with a lub-dub pulse, turning a little side to side as small hearts drift up behind it.

name: Icosahedron
note: A twenty-faced solid turning on two axes, every triangular facet lit flat in shades of teal.

name: Klein Bottle
note: A Klein bottle turning slowly, its narrow neck curling back through the side to join the base, the two sides of the one surface lit violet and teal.

name: Lit Sphere
note: A shaded ball with red, yellow and blue panels turning on a tilted axis, with a bright glint and a soft floor shadow.

name: Mobius Strip
note: A one-sided band with a half twist turning slowly, its colour shifting from teal to violet as it travels around the loop.

name: Octahedron
note: An eight-faced gem spinning on its axis and rocking gently, with faces lit in alternating violet and blue.

name: Puzzle Cube Turns
note: A three by three colour puzzle cube turning while its layers twist one quarter turn at a time, scrambling and then solving itself.

name: Pyramid
note: A square pyramid turning slowly above its shadow, each sandstone face lit flat with bright edges.

name: Rotating Cube
note: A solid cube tumbling on two axes, each face lit flat with a character ramp and crisp bright edges.

name: Dodecahedron
note: A solid dodecahedron tumbling on three axes, its twelve pentagon faces lit in blue, amber and green with crisp edges.

name: Rotating Star
note: A thick five-pointed gold star extruded in 3D, spinning on its axis and catching the light on its bevels.

name: Sphere to Cube Morph
note: A turning solid that swells from a smooth ball into a sharp cube and back, each of its six sides painted its own colour.

name: Spinning Gold Coin
note: A thick gold coin with a raised star and a ridged rim spinning on its edge, its shadow stretching and shrinking on the floor below.

name: Spinning Torus
note: A lit ring turning slowly on two axes, shaded with a classic character ramp.

name: Spring Coil
note: A steel coil spring hanging from a beam, stretching and recoiling under a turning weight, lit with a bright metallic glint.

name: Terrain Mesh Flyover
note: A low flight over an endless gridded landscape, green valleys rising to rocky ridges and snowy peaks that sweep toward the camera under a dusk sky.

name: Tesseract
note: A four dimensional hypercube turning through the fourth axis, its inner and outer cubes swapping places as it projects down.

name: Torus Knot
note: A glossy tube tied in a trefoil torus knot, turning slowly, lit and depth-sorted so it passes over and under itself.

name: Candy Trefoil Tube
note: A fat red and cream striped tube tied in a trefoil knot, the stripes flowing around the loop while the knot slowly turns.

name: Voxel Heart
note: A chunky heart built from small red cubes, turning slowly and giving a double beat every couple of seconds.

name: Wireframe City Flyby
note: A night flight down a long avenue between wireframe towers, cyan and magenta edges racing past over a gridded street.

name: Wireframe Globe
note: A wire sphere of latitude and longitude lines turning on a tilted axis, near lines bright and far lines dim behind.
